    (hr : r+6 ≤ m) (hshape : canon (dsOf p r 6) = [0,1,2,0,3,2])

      hamming (vx p (r+2)) (vx p k) = 2 ∧
      hamming (vx p (r+4)) (vx p k) = 2 :=
